title: First stop. So many stories.
subject: Eight nights in Curaçao. A lot happened. 🌴
paragraphs: POSTCARDS FROM DAINYEL Take the scenic route.
Curaçao was the first stop of this new chapter, and somehow eight nights went by in a blink. 🌴
There were beach days, late-night food trucks, a surprise festival, family dinners and a mountain hike that was sweatier than I'd expected.
I've put the full story—including a few honest tips and the little moments that made it special—on the website.
Come along and read how the journey began!
See you on the scenic route, Dainyel
